name: set_text_window_pointer_position

stack.evidence: func_001CDD18 consumes a window ID and position index and stores the index at window descriptor +0x08; when the window is not following a world target, func_0010B0D0 divides indices 0 through 19 into four groups of five and maps them to successive positions around the window perimeter

notes: Observed configured position indices are 0, 1, 3, 4, 5, 13, 14, 15, and 17.
